claim: The Port Authority's 2007 financial statement reported approximately $4.57 billion in total World Trade Center insurance recovery against approximately $4.68 billion in available policy limits. A New York State Comptroller review reported the rounded total as $4.55 billion and said the final $2 billion settlement allocated $870 million to the Port Authority and $1.13 billion to Silverstein.

sources.label: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey — 2007 Financial Statements, World Trade Center insurance recovery
sources.quote: Such settlement provided for a total recovery of approximately $4.57 billion against available policy limits of approximately $4.68 billion.

sources.label: New York State Comptroller — Review of the Financial Plan, World Trade Center insurance settlement
sources.quote: This brings the total amount to be paid by all of the 23 original WTC insurers to $4.55 billion

sources.quote: A federal jury ruled Monday that the Sept. 11 attack on the World Trade Center was two occurrences for insurance purposes
